text:
Riley: Quick sync — we need a compact battlecard + two benchmark blurbs for next Monday's launch. Keep it skimmable and field-ready.

Harpreet: Top deliverables: 3 hero claims, 3 short rebuttals, 2 bench narratives (methodology callouts), 1 paste-ready routing snippet, and a webinar demo script.

Nate: New angle: highlight bench transparency. Call out dataset sources, seed prompts, and how we replay production-like traffic. Avoid hero-level numbers; use 'typical outcomes' and link to the methodology appendix.

Sofia: For messaging vs cloud AI: lean into 'operational guarantees' not 'we're faster'. Soundbite: "Same API. Operate with confidence."

Riley: SDR battlecard needs: 15s elevator, 30s pitch, 3 rebuttals, and a 1-line demo script. Example rebuttal: 'We already have managed endpoints' -> 'Keep them; Redwood layers runtime controls, rollout safety, and cost transparency on top.'

Harpreet: Bench narratives (short):
- Chat-first SaaS: replay prod prompts with realistic token distribution -> outcome: batching+KV cache smooths p95 and reduces tail unit cost. Method: 7-day prompt sample + user-order replay.
- Analytics ingest: spike tests with variable seq length -> outcome: routing + prewarmed pools preserve availability. Method: staged ramp + canary-induced failure to validate fallback.

Nate: Webinar plan: 3m positioning, 6m bench methodology (open notebook link), 10m scripted demo (force a failure -> show rollback), 10m panel Q&A, 1m CTA. Make demo repeatable.

Sofia: Paste-ready routing snippet for SDR playbook:
```
# simple routing pseudo
policy = load_policy(customer_id)
if policy.reserved_available < policy.threshold:
  forward(req, variant='hosted_compat')
  emit_metric('fallback.triggered')
else:
  forward(req, variant='reserved_primary')
```

event-bot: Landing page created -> /events/serve-transparent. Recording room reserved Thu 10:00 PT.

Riley: Timeline: draft battlecard by Tue noon, bench blurbs + methodology appendix by Wed, final SDR playbook + Intercom flows by Fri. Assignments: Harpreet -> bench appendix + methodology link; Nate -> demo script + fallback GIFs; Sofia -> SDR one-pager + email subject A/B. I'll compile and post in #marketing-drafts by Friday AM. Keep replies short. :sparkles:
